headline: Samford's season ends at Mississippi State
dek: It was only the third defeat of Samford's year, and its first since September. Peyton Hull kept 11 shutouts behind a defense that conceded 12 goals in all.

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Goals did not settle the table: Mercer and The Citadel each outscored Samford, and both finished in its bottom half while Samford finished level at the top.

wire.line: No side in the conference has a match left to play; Samford's season ended last, at Mississippi State.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Four matches have passed their date with no published result, and none of them is between two conference members.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: VMI finished the season without a win, with one draw beside 19 defeats and 72 goals conceded.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Samford's 37 goals came from at least 15 different scorers.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Furman went through the table unbeaten and then lost to Mercer, a side from the table's bottom half.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Zoe Santos made 100 saves for The Citadel at a .794 save percentage.

last_match.line: Samford had not lost to a conference member all season.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
